_notes: Recorded 2026-11-17 with `ingest record` (real Chrome). Not yet run on the VM.
Unverified until the first VM run: the allowlist's POST patterns and extra hosts
(an unlisted request is aborted in the browser and logged by path shape, so the
first runs reveal them without anything reaching the bank). Verification screen taken from
screenshots: "Push to your device" is preselected, Send, then a 6-digit code and Next; no remember box.
Every account in the download dropdown is fetched (for_each_account). Files are named
after the account's label, e.g. no-fee-chequing-1234__<date>.csv; map each name to a

Allowlist from the first VM runs (2026-11-18): Simplii's own hosts only. The POST with a random five-part path on online.simplii.com is Akamai's bot check; sign-in never starts without it. Analytics, marketing and chat (go-mpulse, adobedtm, braze/appboy, ada.support) stay blocked. w-profiling.simplii.com is Simplii's ThreatMetrix device check (allowed, it's the bank's own host); the third-party online-metrix.net hosts it calls stay blocked unless sign-in turns out to need them. POSTs to Simplii's own JSON API (ebm-anp/api/vN/json/) are allowed: sign-in, code send/check and the download screens all use it, with names that vary; the money-moving blocks (DEFAULT_BLOCK and this script's block list) still apply.
Download Transactions is in the Banking menu's Extras section at the VM's window size (wider windows show it as a left-hand Extras panel).

login.intent: accept the cookie banner if shown
answer a one-time verification code if asked

steps.intent: open the Banking menu (its Extras section holds Download Transactions)
open download transactions from the Banking menu

empty.text: There are no transactions found that meet your request
